name: The Ritz-Carlton, Tianjin
positioning: Neoclassical downtown hotel in Tianjin, near the railway station, with a China rose-themed spa and an in-house art collection
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Tianjin base, half an hour from Beijing by high-speed train
Families with children aged four to eight, who can join the Ritz Kids program

facts.text: The hotel is located downtown near the railway station in Tianjin.
Tianjin is half an hour from Beijing by high-speed train.
Tian Tai Xuan serves Cantonese and Tianjin dishes in a fine-dining setting.
The hotel has four restaurants and bars.
Zest is built within the hotel's courtyard and has three private dining rooms in addition to the main hall.
The spa has two relaxation lounges and eight treatment rooms.
The spa and fitness area has Technogym exercise equipment, an indoor swimming pool, and sauna and steam facilities.
Guest rooms and suites have balconies with a city, garden or courtyard view.

highlights.text: The hotel presents more than 1,200 pieces of artwork on display, with background stories from the western to the eastern world.
The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Tianjin has the China rose as its emblem and uses ESPA products in its signature treatments.
The Club Lounge is designed as a residential concept with five areas: an open kitchen, a private dining room, a family room, a library and a bar.
The Ritz Kids program is designed for children aged four to eight and is guided by the culture, history and setting of Tianjin.
Transportation is offered in a Rolls Royce or Bentley.

considerations.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
The spa requires an appointment, and online reservations are not available.
WhataHotel notes the business district location may feel less cultural for leisure travelers.
